content: Dr. Niveen Abu-Rmeileh is a professor at the Institute of Community and Public Health at Birzeit University, located in the occupied Palestinian territory, including East Jerusalem. Professor Mario Festin is affiliated with the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at the University of the Philippines, College of Medicine, in Manila, Philippines. Dr. Atf Ghérissi serves as an assistant professor at the Faculty of Health Sciences and Techniques at Tunis El Manar University in Tunis, Tunisia. Mrs. Gill Gyte is a consumer editor for the Cochrane Pregnancy and Childbirth Group, based at the Liverpool Women’s NHS Foundation Trust in Liverpool, United Kingdom. Professor Tippawan Liabsuetrakul is the head of the Epidemiology Unit at the Faculty of Medicine, Prince of Songkla University, in Songkhla, Thailand. Professor James Neilson, who chairs the Guideline Development Group (GDG), is the coordinating editor for the Cochrane Pregnancy and Childbirth Group at the Liverpool Women’s NHS Foundation Trust in Liverpool, United Kingdom. Dr. Lisa M. Noguchi is the director of Maternal and Newborn Health at Jhpiego, based in Baltimore, Maryland, USA. Professor Nafissa Osman is an associate professor at the Faculty of Medicine, Eduardo Mondlane University, in Maputo, Mozambique. Professor Erika Ota is a professor of Global Health Nursing at the Graduate School of Nursing Science, St. Luke’s International University, in Tokyo, Japan. Dr. Tomas Pantoja is a professor and family physician in the Department of Family Medicine at the Faculty of Medicine, Pontifical Catholic University of Chile, in Santiago, Chile. Professor Robert Pattinson is the director of the South African Medical Research Council (SAMRC)/University of Pretoria Maternal and Infant Health Care Strategies Research Unit, located in Pretoria, South Africa. Dr. Charlotte Warren is the director of the Ending Eclampsia Project and a senior associate in Maternal and Newborn Health at the Population Council in Washington, D.C., USA. Professor Charles Shey Wiysonge is the director of the South Africa Cochrane Centre at the South African Medical Research Council in Cape Town, South Africa. Dr. Soo Downe is a professor in Midwifery Studies at the University of Central Lancashire in Preston, United Kingdom. Dr. Therese Dowswell is a systematic reviewer at The Evidence-Based Medicine Consultancy Ltd., based in Bath, United Kingdom. Kenneth Finlayson is a senior research assistant at the University of Central Lancashire in Preston, United Kingdom. Dr. Theresa Lawrie is the director of The Evidence-Based Medicine Consultancy Ltd., located in Bath, United Kingdom. Gillian Moncrieff is a research fellow at the National Institute for Health Research (NIHR) at the University of Central Lancashire in Preston, United Kingdom. Deborah Armbruster is a senior maternal and newborn health advisor at the United States Agency for International Development (USAID), Center for Population, Health, and Nutrition, in Washington, D.C., USA. Dr. Anwar Nassar is the director of projects for the International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics (FIGO) and is based at the American University of Beirut in Beirut, Lebanon. Dr. Liona Poon is a trustee of the International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology (ISUOG) and is based in Hong Kong SAR, China. Dr. Jeffrey Smith is the deputy director of the Maternal, Newborn, and Child Health Team at the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation in Seattle, Washington, USA. Mary Ellen Stanton is a senior advisor at USAID’s Center for Population, Health, and Nutrition in Washington, D.C., USA. Petra ten Hoope-Bender is a technical adviser for Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights at the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) in Geneva, Switzerland. Anne Yates is a global midwifery adviser for the German Association of Midwives and a representative for the International Confederation of Midwives, based in Germany. Dr. Lorena Binfa is a professor in the Department of Women’s and Newborn Health Promotion at the Faculty of Medicine, University of Chile, in Santiago, Chile. Dr. Tamar Kabakian-Khasholian is an associate professor in Health Promotion and Community Health at the Faculty of Health Sciences, American University of Beirut, in Beirut, Lebanon. Bhavya Reddy is a senior research associate at the Ramalingaswami Centre on Equity and Social Determinants of Health, Public Health Foundation of India, in Bangalore, India. Dr. Petr Velebil is an obstetrician at the Perinatal Centre of the Institute for the Care of Mother and Child in Prague, Czechia.
